label: 14700: Consumer price index, by goods and services and month
note: On sub-group levels a code is attached to the text, meaning services (S), non-durables (ND), semi-durables (SD) or durables (D).

This table replaces [table 03013](https://www.ssb.no/en/statbank/table/03013).

As of 2026 the reference year is 2025=100. Rates of change calculated from the 2015=100 series may differ from published rates of change before 2026 with another reference year. The deviations are mainly due to rounding effects. [See the completed table 03013](https://www.ssb.no/en/statbank/table/03013) for published rates of change for the period 2017 to 2025 with 2015=100, or [table 11446](https://www.ssb.no/en/statbank/table/11446) for published rates of change figures through 2016 with 1998=100. As of January 2016 UNs' consumer classification COICOP2018 is applied.
